record.name: Quartermaster
record.description: Quartermasters are masters of logistics and supply management. They excel at negotiating deals, managing resources, and ensuring their faction has everything it needs to operate effectively.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Logistics masters with a keen eye for supply and demand.

progression_tree.description: You have mastered the art of logistical planning, allowing you to allocate resources more efficiently.

effects.value: Take a bonus action to reorganize your supplies and equipment.

progression_tree.description: You have developed connections with suppliers, granting you access to rare materials and resources.

effects.value: React when a merchant or supplier offers you an unusual item or service.

progression_tree.description: You have honed your ability to manage resources, allowing you to store and retrieve equipment with ease.

effects.value: Add a number of equipment slots equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).

progression_tree.description: You have developed exceptional negotiation skills, allowing you to persuade even the most reluctant parties.
You have become a master of supply chain management, granting you unparalleled access to resources and materials.

effects.value: Gain access to rare and unusual items, as well as unique equipment and supplies.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a defensive stance, lightsaber at the ready with a deep breathing rhythm
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Exudes an aura of controlled efficiency, with subtle hums emanating from nearby datapads

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A seasoned Quartermaster surveys a busy docking bay, surrounded by stacks of crates and workers hustling to meet demand
